name: Albérick Euraste Djiré
title: PhD Candidate in Computer Science
bio: I am a first-year PhD student at the University of Luxembourg, working with SnT / TruX on the evaluation of data leakage and memorization in large language models. I'm broadly interested in the design and reliability of digital systems, with a focus on how LLMs behave when applied to code and software engineering tasks.
about: Before starting my PhD in March 2024, I worked as an AI researcher at CITADEL (Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso) on synthetic voice generation and deepfake audio detection, and as a web developer and network technician on various infrastructure and platform projects. My current research sits at the intersection of AI4SE (AI for Software Engineering) and trustworthy machine learning — asking whether large language models genuinely generalize or simply memorize the data they were trained on.
